# table=freq: value frequency over WALS languages coded for that feature (count / n). Raw languages, not genus-balanced (Dryer's own counts balance by genus; these do not).

# table=crosstab: 81A value (rows) vs feature2 value; count = languages coded for both; fraction = count / n (n = languages with that 81A value coded for feature2), i.e. P(feature2 value | 81A value). The task asked for 85A and 86A; 87A, 88A, 90A are included as well since they are the same size.
